author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration. Book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike. Open to different styles; share work/recs. Bonus points for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for the time being; if the art style fits the series it can turn into more. For the map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact via Threads reply or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. Looking for artists that draw anime/manga style illustrations, cartoon/semi-cartoon illustration, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic illustrations, and any other art styles. Comment if interested or DM directly. Follow-up: still checking portfolios; send a link to previous works if not sent yet. Contact via comment or DM @blekek.k.

author: yuanxin_289
title: Freelance graphic designer for client visuals
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for social media visuals, ads creatives, campaign posters, and simple visual adaptations/resizing. Prefer someone with a good eye for clean and modern design, who can follow brand guidelines/references, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Contact via Threads @yuanxin_289.
